description: This file implements a NVIDIA Riva TTS (Text-to-Speech) service class, integrating with NVIDIA's Riva cloud-based TTS models via gRPC API. It includes class definitions, methods for initialization, configuration, and speech synthesis, and handles external dependencies such as riva.client.

classes.name: NvidiaTTSService
classes.description: A class providing integration with NVIDIA Riva's cloud TTS services, supporting configuration and speech synthesis.

classes.name: NvidiaTTSService.InputParams
classes.description: A nested class defining input parameters such as language and quality for TTS configuration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the NVIDIA Riva TTS service with API key, server, voice, and model configuration.

methods.name: set_model
methods.description: Method to attempt to set the TTS model, but operation is not supported after initialization.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronous generator method that synthesizes speech from text, yielding audio frames or errors.
